title: Cancer vs Scorpio: Who, When, Why
old_caption: Someone said "I can't sleep" and Scorpio opened an investigation. Cancer offered a boring bedtime story instead. Which reply would you want at 2 AM?

title: Gemini vs Sagittarius: Nice Save
old_caption: Gemini tried "lie to me, it's cozier" and walked it back fast. Sag kept it honest, but gentle. Tag your friend who needs the gentle part.

title: Libra vs Aquarius: A Theory of Missing
old_caption: Libra says "miss you too." Aquarius says missing is just distance with feelings. Both cute, only one of them answered the text. Which one have you dated?

title: Cancer vs Capricorn: Soup, Again
old_caption: Capricorn said an actual feeling on stage. Cancer still won by asking first and holding the soup. Which sign makes a 5-step plan when you just need a hug?

title: Scorpio vs Pisces: The Bigger Half
old_caption: One last slice, two water signs, and a lot of tissues. Pisces gave it away and cried. Scorpio split it and gave them the bigger half. Splitter or giver?

title: Leo vs Aquarius: Same Story Twice
old_caption: Your date tells the same story twice. Leo offers a better story, about Leo. Aquarius just laughs again. Who's the Aquarius in your life?

title: Gemini vs Aquarius: Silence Is Allowed
old_caption: Your date goes quiet and Gemini has fun facts ready. All of them. Aquarius just sits with them. Are you a fun facts person or a sit-in-silence person?

title: Virgo vs Pisces: The Spare Key
old_caption: Pisces cried for them. Virgo showed up with the spare key and a snack. Rematch settled. Who's your spare-key friend?

title: Cancer vs Pisces: Finale
old_caption: Finale night: Cancer vs Pisces, two podiums, zero dry eyes. Last question, and they both just hugged. Which sign cried hardest at your last goodbye?
